meta.description: Polls Supabase hubstaff_uploads every 5 minutes and emails an alert when a new upload row appears. Uses workflow static data as a cursor (lastSeenUploadedAt) so each upload is alerted exactly once; the first run silently seeds the cursor. Set the Supabase project URL in the HTTP node, attach a Supabase API credential (service_role key) and an SMTP credential, then edit fromEmail/toEmail.
